status.evidence: According to Companies House and Business Doncaster, Connected Vehicle Solutions Ltd is an active Doncaster-based company incorporated in February 2024 and led by Managing Director Jason Craven.

claims.claim: The company reports that its asset trackers feature up to a 10-year battery life for long-term monitoring of plant machinery and trailers, as published on the Connected Vehicle Solutions Ltd website.
claims.source: Connected Vehicle Solutions Official Website Asset Trackers Page (https://connectedvehiclesolutions.co.uk/asset-trackers)

claims.claim: The company reports that its cloud-based connected fleet platform provides single-system integration for tracking, cameras, and driver data while supporting compatibility with a customer's existing hardware, according to the Connected Vehicle Solutions Official Website (https://connectedvehiclesolutions.co.uk/).
The company filed total exemption full accounts as a micro-entity with the UK Companies House registry for the financial period ending March 31, 2025.
claims.source: UK Companies House Registry Filing History for Company 15503902 (https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/15503902/filing-history)

claims.claim: An independent corporate registry profile categorizes the company as a micro-sized business with an estimated turnover under £1 million and a balance sheet under £500,000.
claims.source: Endole Corporate Registry Profile for Connected Vehicle Solutions Ltd (https://open.endole.co.uk/insight/company/15503902-connected-vehicle-solutions-ltd)

claims.claim: The company reports working primarily with business partners, stating in its official documentation that it coordinates with insurance companies, telematics service providers, lease companies, and resellers to distribute its hardware and cloud platform.
claims.note: The details regarding specific coordination with insurance companies, telematics service providers, lease companies, and resellers to distribute hardware and platforms are unconfirmed on the official website or documentation.

claims.claim: Connected Vehicle Solutions Ltd maintains a small-scale footprint with an employee headcount tracked between 2 and 10 employees according to its professional profile.
claims.source: Connected Vehicle Solutions Ltd LinkedIn Profile
